Name: Cooler Weapons Recolors
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[center][size=6][i][b]~ Cooler Weapons ~[/b]
[/i]
[/size][size=4]Sam's guitar is now a lollipop <3
[/size]
Not long ago, I made the cooler tools mod, but unfortunately I couldn't 
do the scythe, since it was considered a weapon.
So, decided to make the whole weapon spritesheet!

I made pink, blue, green... 
Dark, cute, shiny....
I recolored all the weapons in different styles,
to have some variety.

Hope you like it!! <3 

[u]I'm open to any suggestions!!
[/u]Plus: If anybody wants a custom spritesheet from these (For example, 
if you want me to change a color of a weapon of these, or want
any sword longer, or to shine, etc etc...) feel completely free
to text me! I'll be pleased![/center]


[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
